DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらはお客様へ連絡する携帯番号の欄です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: This field is for your mobile number so we can contact you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社の番号を書きました。仕事中は会社へかけてほしいと思ったので。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人欄に会社番号を書いた理由を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote the company number because I wanted you to call there while I'm working.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain why you wrote the company number in the personal field. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 勤務先の電話と本人の連絡先は別の欄です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your workplace phone and personal contact go in separate fields.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の携帯はこちらの番号です。勤務先の番号は、会社の代表で私の直通ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 携帯と会社代表の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is my mobile number. The workplace number is the company's main line, not my direct number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between your mobile and the company's main line. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人へ確実に連絡できる番号を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll confirm a number where we can reliably contact you personally.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 携帯に変更します。仕事中は出られないので、折り返してよい番号も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人番号へ直し折返しの確認方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll change it to my mobile. I can't answer during work, so please also tell me which number I can call back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct your personal number and ask how to check callback details. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 銀行からの連絡の場合に確認する方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll explain how to check a call from the bank.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。会社番号は勤務先欄へ書くか、担当に確認してから記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務先欄の取扱いを別に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'll ask the person responsible whether to put the company number in the workplace field before filling it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check separately how to handle the workplace field. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。誤記した携帯欄は訂正しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Let's correct the mistaken entry in the mobile field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 直しました。自分の携帯と会社の代表番号を最後に別々に読み合わせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二つの番号を欄別に照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've corrected it. At the end I'd like to read back my mobile and the company's main number separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare the two numbers in their separate fields. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。欄ごとに確認します。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品の日付が気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you concerned about the product's date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この日付は昨日です。もう期限を過ぎていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 製造日を期限として尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. This date is yesterday. Has it already expired?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the manufacturing date as though it were the expiry date. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それは製造日です。期限はこちらに別の表示があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: That is the manufacturing date. The expiry date is shown separately here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日作った日と、期限は違うんですね。明日の昼に食べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 翌日の利用予定を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So yesterday's manufacture date and the expiry are different. I'd like to eat it tomorrow at lunchtime.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your plan to use it the following day. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 期限だけでなく、保存方法もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the storage instructions as well as the expiry date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 冷蔵とあります。持ち帰って冷蔵庫へ入れますが、期限の数字はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 冷蔵条件と期限欄を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says refrigerated. I'll put it in my fridge when I get home, but which number is the expiry?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the refrigeration condition and expiry field. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの「消費期限」の欄です。時刻の記載もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This “use-by” field. It includes a time too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明日の午前までですね。明日の昼には合わないので、別の商品を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 時刻を見て最初の商品をやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's only until tomorrow morning. That won't suit tomorrow lunchtime, so I'll choose another product.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the time and decide against the first product. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 利用予定に合う物の表示を見比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Compare the labels to find something that suits your plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらは明日の午後までと確認しました。製造日の早さだけでは選ばないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 利用時刻に合う代替品を表示で選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked that this one lasts until tomorrow afternoon. I'll avoid choosing just by how recent the manufacture date is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose an alternative whose label suits the intended use time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。購入後も表示どおりに保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please store it according to the label after purchase too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 夕方の撮影ですか。帰りの道はお分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Taking photos in the evening? Do you know your way back?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。暗くなってから光る景色を撮りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜景待ちと未知の帰路を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. I want to photograph the illuminated scenery after dark.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you are waiting for a night view but do not know the return route. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず出口までの道と閉園時刻を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: First check the route to the exit and the closing time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 地図だけ見ていました。明るいうちに道を歩いて確かめてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 明るいうちの経路確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was only looking at the map. Can I walk the route while it's light to check it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to check the route while it is light. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どうぞ。この舗装路が出口につながっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Certainly. This paved path leads to the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一度行って戻りました。街灯のない細道は使わず、この道から帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 歩いて確認した舗装路を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've walked there and back once. I'll return along this path, not the narrow unlit path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the paved route you have checked on foot. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 閉園までに出口へ向かえる範囲でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait only where you can head to the exit before closing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 閉園が日没より早ければ、夜景はここでは撮れないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日没と閉園の順序を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If closing is before sunset, I can't take night-view photos here, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the order of sunset and closing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。閉園の案内を優先してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's right. Please give priority to the closing instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 時刻を確認して、今日は夕景だけにします。帰路を覚えた舗装路で出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 夕景へ目的を変え退園する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the time, so today I'll just photograph the evening scenery. I'll leave by the paved return route I learned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Change your aim to evening photos and leave the park. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。時間に余裕を持ってお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please leave with plenty of time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ホームまでの経路についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the route to the platform?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。足首を痛めたので、階段を使わず行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 足首の事情と階段回避を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I've hurt my ankle and want to go without using stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your ankle condition and wish to avoid stairs. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: エレベーターの経路があります。少し遠回りになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: There's a route using the lift. It's a little longer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 距離は歩けます。ただ、小さな段差もあるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小さな段差の有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can walk the distance. But please tell me whether there are even small steps.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether there are small steps. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 途中の扉の所に低い段差があります。案内を見ながら進みましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: There's a low step at a door along the way. Let's follow the information as we go.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 足を上げられるか、そこまで行って確かめたいです。無理なら支援を相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現場を見て支援を相談したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to go there and check whether I can lift my foot over it. If I can't, can I ask about assistance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to see the spot and discuss assistance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な支援は係員へお申し出ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask a staff member for the assistance you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。速く歩くのは難しいので、次の列車に間に合わなくても構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 速さを求めず列車を見送れると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Walking fast is difficult, so I don't mind if I miss the next train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you do not need speed and can let a train go. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 余裕を持って移動しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's allow plenty of time for the journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 段差の所で止まって判断します。階段がないだけで全部楽だとは考えず進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 段差で移動可否を判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll stop at the step and decide. I won't assume the whole route is easy just because there are no stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide at the step whether you can proceed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。難しい所があれば、その場で係員にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. If any part is difficult, tell a staff member there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入届の確認が済みました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: We've finished checking your moving-in notification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。借りている駐車場の住所も、これで変わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駐車場契約の住所も変わるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Thank you. Does that also change the address on my rented parking-space contract?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the parking contract's address changes too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 民間の契約先の登録は、この届出では変更されません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This notification does not change registrations with private contracting companies.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駐車場の会社には自分で連絡するんですね。料金の請求先も古い住所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧い請求先を自分で変更すると理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I need to contact the parking company myself. The billing address is still my old address too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show you understand you must change the old billing address yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 契約先へ新しい住所と変更希望をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tell the contracting company your new address and request the change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 転入した証明が必要か、相手に先に聞いた方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 証明資料の必要を先方へ聞くか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Should I ask them first whether they need proof that I've moved in?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether to check the need for supporting documents with the other party. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要書類は契約先の指定をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the contracting company's requirements for documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では今すぐ証明書を追加で取らず、管理会社へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定確認まで追加発行を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I won't get an additional certificate right now; I'll ask the management company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Wait for their requirements before obtaining additional documents. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかの手続きの案内はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here's information about the other procedures.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 市役所の届出は済み、駐車場は未変更と分けて控えます。請求書を見て連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 行政届出と未変更契約を分けて控える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll note separately that the city-hall notification is done and the parking contract hasn't changed. I'll check the invoice and contact them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record the administrative notification and unchanged contract separately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。契約先ごとに必要な手続きを確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Check the necessary procedures with each contracting company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 変更候補は火曜の午前か木曜の午後です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: The options for changing are Tuesday morning or Thursday afternoon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 火曜なら家族の車で来られそうです。それで決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 候補を確定と受け取ったか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: On Tuesday, I think my family can drive me. Is that confirmed, then?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the suggested option is a confirmed booking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご希望を伺ってから枠を確認します。まだ確定ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check availability after hearing your preference. It isn't confirmed yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では家族に「候補」と伝えます。車を出せるか今聞いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 候補として家族確認をしたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I'll tell my family it's an option. Can I ask now whether they can drive me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to check with your family while treating it as an option. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どうぞ。確認中に空き状況が変わる可能性はあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do. Availability may change while you are checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 木曜なら送迎できると返事が来ました。木曜の午後を希望します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 送迎可能な木曜を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: They replied they can drive me on Thursday. I'd prefer Thursday afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose Thursday when transport is available. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その枠を確認します。少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check that slot. Please wait a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。火曜は選ばないので、候補を二つとも予約しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二重予約をしない意向を明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I won't choose Tuesday, so please don't reserve both options.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear that you do not want duplicate bookings. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 木曜の予約が取れました。この時刻です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We've booked Thursday. This is the time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今度は確定した時刻として家族へ伝えます。新しい予約票も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確定後に送迎へ正しい時刻を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Now I'll tell my family the confirmed time. I'll check the new appointment slip too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give your driver the correct time after confirmation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。変更後の票をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please take the updated slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車はご自身の物ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 借りた自転車です。返却場所にあると思ったのですが、番号の車体が見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借用車で所在不明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's rented. I thought it was at the return location, but I can't find the bicycle with that number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain it is a borrowed bicycle whose location is unknown. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 返却の操作は完了していましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Had you completed the return process?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: アプリの記録を見ます。完了ではなく「利用中」と出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返却未完了の表示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll check the app record. It says “in use”, not completed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the display showing the return is unfinished. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 管理する事業者へ状態を確認する必要がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You'll need to check the status with the operator that manages it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。私が別の所へ置いてしまった可能性もあります。最後の写真がここです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の置忘れ可能性と写真を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I may have left it somewhere else. Here's the last photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the photo and acknowledge you may have left it elsewhere. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真の場所と、今探した場所は同じでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is the place in the photo the same as where you just looked?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 違いました。写真には川側の看板があります。先に事業者へその場所を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真と探索地点の違いに気付く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It wasn't. The photo shows a sign on the riverside. I'll tell the operator that place first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Notice the difference between the photo and the place searched. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身で確認できた事実を、分けてお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please distinguish the facts you've been able to confirm yourself when reporting them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 盗まれたと断定せず、利用中の表示と置いた可能性のある所を伝えて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 盗難と断定せず管理者へ事実を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't assume it was stolen; I'll report the “in use” display and where I may have left it, and ask for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report facts to the operator without deciding it was theft. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。管理者の確認結果も必要ならお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. If needed, also tell us the operator's findings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発送の記録が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need a record of sending it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。契約書を送ります。ここでもらう控えで相手が受け取ったと証明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発送控えで受領証明できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'm sending a contract. Can the receipt I get here prove the other party received it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a dispatch receipt proves receipt by the recipient. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発送受付の控えと、受け取りの記録は別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: A shipping acceptance receipt and a delivery receipt record are different.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 送った時点では相手はまだ受け取っていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発送時点と受取時点を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: At the time it's sent, the recipient hasn't received it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish dispatch from receipt. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。どのような記録が必要か、契約先の指定をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Check with the other contracting party what kind of record they require.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 指定には到着を確認できる方法とあります。受取状況を追える方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先方の到着確認指定を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Their instructions say a method that allows arrival to be checked. I'd like to ask about a method for tracking receipt status.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the other party's arrival-confirmation requirement. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 追跡などの取扱いをご説明します。証明として十分かは提出先に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll explain tracking and similar options. Please ask the recipient whether that is sufficient as proof.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 説明を聞いて先方へ確かめます。発送控えは受領済みの紙として出さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 説明後に証拠条件を先方へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll listen to the explanation and check with them. I won't submit the dispatch receipt as proof it has already been received.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the evidence requirements with the recipient after the explanation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後に方法を決めていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can decide the method after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この方法でよいと先方から返事が来ました。発送後は記録番号で受取状況も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 了承された方法で送り結果も調べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: They replied this method is acceptable. After sending it, I'll also check receipt status using the reference number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Send by the approved method and check the outcome too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。控えを保管し、配送の結果をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Keep the receipt and check the delivery result.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 給与受取用の口座をお考えですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're considering an account for receiving your salary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。同僚がここを使っているので、私も必ずここで作る必要があると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同僚と同じ銀行が必須と思ったと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My colleague uses this bank, so I thought I had to open one here too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought using the same bank as your colleague was required. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会社から銀行の指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Has your company specified a bank?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この紙です。よく読むと「他の金融機関も可」とあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 他行可の会社案内を読み直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's their paper. Reading carefully, it says other financial institutions are also acceptable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reread the company instructions allowing other banks. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その場合、お持ちの口座が使えるか会社にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: In that case, ask your company whether you can use your existing account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分名義の口座は別の銀行にあります。新しく作る前に会社へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 既存本人名義口座を使えるか会社へ聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have an account in my own name at another bank. I'll ask the company before opening a new one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the company whether your existing account in your own name is usable. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な情報をその口座から確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check the necessary information from that account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社は今の口座でよいと返事をくれました。今日は開設申込みをしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認結果により新規開設をやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The company replied that my current account is fine. I won't apply to open one today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide against opening a new account based on confirmation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。口座情報はご自身で正しく会社へ提出してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please submit your account details correctly to the company yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 銀行名と支店、番号、名義を確認します。同僚の情報を写さず自分の物を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人の口座情報を正確に提出すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the bank, branch, number, and holder's name. I won't copy my colleague's information; I'll submit my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to submit your own account information accurately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのようにお願いします。必要があればまたご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. Come back for advice if needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 値札のことでご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the price tag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。特売の二百円で買いたいのに、通常価格になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 特売が反映されないと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to buy it at the special price of two hundred yen, but it's showing the regular price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask why the special price is not applied. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この札は明日からの予告です。開始日はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This tag is an advance notice for tomorrow. The start date is here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 曜日だけ見て今日と思いました。今日の価格はいくらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 開始日を理解し今日の価格を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only looked at the weekday and thought it meant today. What's today's price?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand the start date and ask today's price. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 三百円です。明日の在庫は今はお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Three hundred yen. We can't promise tomorrow's stock now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日一つ必要なので一つだけ買います。明日買う予定の分は、取り置きできるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要量を減らし翌日取り置きを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I need one today, so I'll buy just one. For the ones planned for tomorrow, can I ask whether they can be reserved?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reduce the quantity and ask about reserving tomorrow's purchase. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この特売では取り置きは受けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We don't accept reservations for this special offer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では明日分を確保したとは考えません。今日は必要な一つでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確保不可を了承し今日の一つを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I won't consider tomorrow's quantity secured. Please give me the one I need today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Accept that stock cannot be reserved and choose one today. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: かごに二つありますが、一つ戻しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: There are two in your basket. Shall I return one?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。一つ戻して今日の三百円で払います。予告の日付も次から見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 余分を戻し通常価格で支払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll return one and pay today's three hundred yen. Next time I'll check the advance notice date too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return the extra one and pay the regular price. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。一つ分でお会計します。
